entries.source: Brandy Hills

This is an area north of Buckland along the eastern shores of Brandywine River until the Brandywood. Girdley Island is the only named point of interest of these hills though they are dotted by small Arnorian ruins. 

 Size: 420 x 340 
 Lairs: 2x Troll Lair, 2x Warg Lair 
 Neutral Structures:
East Carrock

The Carrock was a stony eyot in the upper reaches of the River Anduin, to the north of the Old Ford. The river looped around the rock although there was a ford of stones to the eastern bank, while there was a swirling channel under its western cliff. 

 Size: 352 x 416 
 Lairs: 4x Warg Lair, 2x Goblin Lair 
 Neutral Structures:
Enchanted River

The Enchanted River was a black river in Mirkwood that flowed north from its source in the Mountains of Mirkwood towards the Forest River. 

 Size: 420 x 308 
 Lairs: 2x Drake Lair, 4x Warg Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 2x Inn, 2x Signal Fire
Gardens of Far Harad

The Gardens of Far Harad were described as a remarkable feat of engineering with an ascending series of tiered gardens containing a wide variety of trees, shrubs, and vines, resembling a large green mountain constructed of mud bricks. 

 Size: 420 x 480 
 Lairs: 4x Warg Lair, 2x Goblin Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 1x Signal Fire
Gladden Fields

The Gladden Fields were a marshland located in the vale of the Gladden river, and on the banks of the river Anduin. It was there that the One Ring was lost by Isildur, and found again centuries later by Deagol the Stoor. 

 Size: 460 x 396 
 Lairs: 5x Warg Lair, 4x Goblin Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 1x Signal Fire
Harrowdale

Harrowdale was a deep, north-south valley cut out of the White Mountains by the Snowbourn river in Rohan. 
 At its southern end, between the mountains known as the Starkhorn and Irensaga, stood Dunharrow, a great clifftop refuge of the Rohirrim. 

 Size: 460 x 462 
 Lairs: 2x Troll Lair, 2x Barrow Wight Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 2x Inn, 1x Signal Fire
Mering Stream II

The Great West Road crosses the Mering Stream, a border river that separates Rohan and Gondor. 

 Size: 380 x 340 
 Lairs: 2x Troll Lair, 2x Warg Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 2x Inn
Numenor's Downfall

The island of Numenor was a great civilization of Men that was destroyed due to their pride and rebellion against the will of the Valar. The once-great land was swallowed by the sea, leaving behind only haunting ruins and semi-flooded islands as somber reminders of the folly and transgressions of men. 

 Size: 400 x 430 
 Lairs: 2x Warg Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 1x Signal Fire
Markets of Linhir

Situated at the south of the Gondor, in the confluence of Gilrain and Serni rivers, Linhir is a port city known by its opulent market and services. During the War of the Ring a clash between Invasors of Umbar and Aragorn's Dead Army took place. 

 Size: 536 x 536 
 Lairs: 4x Warg Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 1x Signal Fire
South Road

The South Road connects Minas Tirith with the southern Gondor havens. This wide and well-paved road goes through the lands of Lossarnach and Lebennin, crosses the river Erui and reaches Pelargir. 

 Size: 480 x 437 
 Lairs: 4x Warg Lair, 2x Troll Lair 
 Neutral Structures:2x Ruined Tower
